extra_info_placeholder: Anything important that isn't covered by your resume or LinkedIn - extra projects, facts, metrics...
pregenerate_hint: Pre-run keyword extraction and the soft/medium proposals right after evaluation, instead of waiting until you open the tailoring page. Uses a bit more tokens per evaluated job, but the tailoring page opens already filled in. Only affects manual review - automated auto-apply flows already do this at a high enough score.
pregenerate_min_score_label: Minimum fit score to trigger pre-generation
question_templates_hint: Custom auto-answer rules. When a pasted question contains one of the trigger phrases, the copilot follows your instructions when drafting an answer. Built-in cover letter / summary detection still runs separately.
template_triggers_placeholder: e.g. why do you want to work here, why this company
template_instructions_placeholder: e.g. Keep it under 3 sentences, mention our product focus...
auto_answer_enabled_label: Automatically generate answers (cover letter, summary, and general questions) right after splitting a pasted form
